given: an inactive vehicle with a valid template and schedule slot, and no binding
a Supervisor, an Administrator, a Crew member, and a Supply Officer

two item obligations created by a binding effective while the vehicle is active, both due at or after a proposed unbind instant: one whose early window has already opened at that instant and one whose window has not
when: the Supervisor records a binding while the vehicle is inactive, then the vehicle is activated
the Administrator records a future binding and time advances from before its effective instant to that instant
Crew and Supply Officer attempt the same binding through direct requests
a user requests an unbind preview, then the list changes before confirmation (an obligation is generated or completed, or time passes)
the user confirms against the fresh preview, then replays the same operation id
then: the Supervisor and Administrator are allowed to bind and unbind; Crew and Supply Officer are denied server-side
no obligations are generated while the vehicle is inactive; an in-force binding owes those due at or after activation
the future binding owes only obligations due at or after its effective instant, if the vehicle is active
the unbind preview lists the obligation not yet in its window as superseded and the one already in its window as continuing, and states that unbinding satisfies no obligation
after unbinding, the superseded obligation is not owed, is not counted as Overdue or Missed, does not affect readiness and is never shown as satisfied; the in-window obligation stays owed
confirmation whose recomputed lists differ from the preview is refused, nothing changes, and a fresh preview is shown
obligations due before unbinding retain their state; checks, deficiencies and audit history remain
replaying the confirmed operation id does not apply unbinding a second time
notes: Language-neutral contract for owner-approved SPEC amendment 4.1.0 (issue #177). The scenario is not yet bound to application commands.
